name: Clock Up Fan Disc 2GHz
source:
"Ghz" is the codename for CLOCKUP's line of fandisks, and this second release is basically a tribute to the most popular (and tragic) character of ECLIPSE, embellished with new graphics and new sex scenarios.
Basically an unvoiced prequel of ECLIPSE, it does add something new (and unexpected, too!) to the original story...


[From a [url=http://www.jastusa.com/forums/viewtopic.php?f=16&t=5389]forum post[/url] by Baldo]
translation:
“GHz”是CLOCKUP旗下Fan Disc系列的代号。本系列第二部作品主要向《ECLIPSE》中最受欢迎（也最具悲剧色彩）的角色致敬，并加入新图像与新的性爱故事。
本作基本相当于一部没有配音的《ECLIPSE》前传，同时也为原作故事增添了一些全新内容——而且相当出人意料！

[摘自Baldo的一篇[url=http://www.jastusa.com/forums/viewtopic.php?f=16&t=5389]论坛帖子[/url]]
